audit.why: 52.11% over 1493 games. LeBlanc out-ranges her through lane (Sigil 700 vs Q 525) and Qiyana takes over late off terrain resets. Chart (LeBlanc x6, Qiyana at 2+ items) agrees across layers and with the packet.
Qiyana's spikes are Audacity ranking down from 11s to 7s and her ultimate at 6 (flat 120s). LeBlanc's are 3, 6 and first item. Already reflected; the cooldown numbers were missing and are now stated.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns added to spikes and the cooldowns field.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate kit errors: 'she has no gap closer without terrain nearby' (Audacity is a 650-range dash to an enemy and needs no terrain), 'keep track of her Q charges' (Q is a flat 7s, no charges), 'her Q needs terrain to threaten you back' (Q works unenchanted; Terrashape only adds the element effect), and 'Use Q knock-up' (the knock-up is her ultimate, Supreme Display of Talent).
audit.why: The whole spacing rule against Qiyana is Audacity's 650 range and its 11s-to-7s cooldown, and that is exactly what the page removed by tying her engage to walls.
audit.corrected: Audacity restated as the engage with its range and cooldown; Terrashape restated as the 1100-range enchant dash; the knock-up reattributed to R.

edits.before: Levels 1-2 you outrange her completely — Sigil poke from max range punishes her for approaching walls to set up terrain Q, and she has no answer until she hits a wall combo. Play a poke lane and never let her E to you first.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 you outrange her: Sigil reaches 700 and her Q only 525, so punish every step she takes toward a wall she wants Terrashape on. Play a poke lane and never let Audacity land on you first, because that dash is what starts her whole combo.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 your full combo threatens to kill her from range before she can close the gap through the wall-dash sequence, so keep track of her Q charges and only trade when she's out of terrain range. At 6, Mimic-Chain deletes her from a full clear, but hold R in reserve to blink away if her jungler shows for a coordinated dive.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 your full combo kills her from range before Terrashape into Audacity can close, so trade when she is away from walls — her Q is a flat 7 seconds rather than a charge system, and it only bites hard while the weapon is enchanted. At 6, Mimic-Chain deletes her, but hold R in reserve if her jungler shows for a coordinated dive.

edits.before: Once she has an item and roams with jungler pressure she becomes a real threat in skirmishes — her wall-resets let her reposition mid-fight and burst backline carries. Keep vision on river walls, don't walk in alone, and use your R to disengage rather than force fights once teams group.
edits.after: Once she has an item and roams with jungler pressure she is a real skirmish threat: Terrashape re-enchants off any wall within 1100 and her ultimate stuns everyone near the element it detonates, on a flat 120 seconds. Keep vision on the river walls, don't walk in alone, and use your R to leave rather than to start.

notes: Four kit errors removed: Audacity was described as needing terrain (it is a 650-range dash to an enemy on 11s), Q was given 'charges' (flat 7s), Q was credited with the knock-up (that is Supreme Display of Talent), and Elemental Wrath was called her engage.
